Preserve the same warm pale-stone colosseum, densely packed spectator stands, purple banners, sand, angled daylight and painterly medium. Image2 confirms original costume and daggers ONLY, never reuse its upright sitting pose.
CHANGE the composition and action into unmistakable exhausted defeat. Show her fallen heavily onto one hip and partly face-down across the arena sand, torso and shoulders slumped very low, one cheek almost touching the bent forearm on the ground, other arm limp outward with empty relaxed fingers. Her legs are slack behind and to one side with believable connected hip/knee/ankle joints and natural weight; spread tunic panels settle on the sand, preserving existing coverage. Both daggers have fallen completely from her hands and lie separately on the sand near the slack arms, exactly two weapons total. The defeat must be emotional and legible: natural side-profile face tilted down toward the sand, eyebrows pinched and raised in distress, eyes half-closed or tightly closed, lips trembling and parted in a pained grimace, clear dejection and despair. NO direct camera gaze, NO confident smirk, NO calm ordinary expression. Preserve her face design without forcing a face-forward pose. Hair falls under gravity and sticks to her damp cheek. Do not hide the whole face behind hair.
Serious cold-weapon combat aftermath: visible shallow cuts and blood streaks on cheek and one exposed upper arm, blood smeared on black glove and white sleeve edge, a modest dark-red patch mixed with sand beneath the forearm, dusty and abraded tunic hem and stockings. A small split in an already covered tunic panel is acceptable but do not reveal additional body. No severed parts, exposed organs or deep graphic tissue. The battle damage and blood must be visible at795x596, not only faint decorative scratches.
A continuous coherently painted scene, believable body scale and perspective, dense contact shadow where cheek, forearm, hip, cloth and legs meet sand, impressed sand under her weight, warm sand bounce reflected onto the same skin and cloth, no floating body parts or pasted-background look. Readable adult anatomy, exactly two arms/hands/legs, human ears, no added boots or accessories. Serious hand-painted dark fantasy game art with anime-influenced character drawing, controlled visible painterly planes and selective edges; not a photograph, plastic CGI, glossy fashion portrait, blur filter or pixel mosaic. No text, frame, UI or watermark.
